repository.name: dispatch
repository.provenance: First-party local fixture · not an external GitHub repository
repository.description: A small task application with explicit boundaries between routing, services, domain and storage.

files.description: Composes the store, service and command router into a single application.
Exposes three transport-independent task commands. No HTTP server is running.
Coordinates title validation, task storage and domain transitions.
Provides an in-memory store through a small get, save and list interface.
Defines the task contract and the immutable completion transition.
Checks and normalizes an unknown title using the configured length limit.
Declares the application name and the shared title-length limit.
